biggest_catch: This is T-Mobile's 'changed your mind' insurance: you must activate a NEW T-Mobile account/voice line, port in from a listed participating carrier, contact T-Mobile BEFORE switching back, and complete the switch-back within 30 days. The $125 comes as a virtual prepaid Mastercard — no cash access, expires in 6 months.
catches: You must contact T-Mobile before switching back to your old carrier — switch back on your own and you get nothing.
The switch-back must be completed within 30 days of activating the new T-Mobile line.
You must port in from a listed participating carrier; not every carrier qualifies.
The $125 is a virtual prepaid Mastercard: no cash access, expires in 6 months, allow about five weeks for delivery.
Up to 12 eligible lines — but each line must independently meet the switch-back conditions.

c2.evidence: Official T-Mobile 'how to join us' page states: $125 virtual prepaid Mastercard per eligible line, up to 12 lines, for customers who switch back within 30 days after contacting T-Mobile first.

c3.evidence: No enrollment fee; you pay for the new T-Mobile line's service during the trial window.

c4.evidence: Official page states the virtual card has no cash access, expires in six months, and to allow about five weeks.

eligibility: New T-Mobile account with a new voice line; port your number in from a listed participating carrier; contact T-Mobile before switching back; complete the switch-back to your prior carrier within 30 days of activation.

steps: Activate a new T-Mobile account with a new voice line and port your number in from a listed participating carrier.
Try the service — but BEFORE you decide to switch back, contact T-Mobile as the offer requires.
Complete your switch back to your prior carrier within 30 days of the T-Mobile activation.
Your $125 virtual prepaid Mastercard per eligible line (up to 12) arrives in about five weeks.
Spend it online or in-store via accepted mobile payment apps before it expires in 6 months (no cash access).
